240-5470-6797-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1395-5078-5223-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2639-3254-4050-7896.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-7896.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Mirkwood Nurturer and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mirkwood Nurturer enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Mirkwood Nurturer and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-7896.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

670-1619-3175-4050-4681.easyPrerequisites: Sefris' first ability hasn't triggered this turn.
670-1619-3175-4050-4681.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in the second to last room of any dungeon.
670-1619-3175-4050-4681.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Sefris' first ability triggers, causing you to venture into the final room of a dungeon, causing you to complete the dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Sefris and Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sefris trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into the Cave Entrace room, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into either available room.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Sefris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
Repeat.
670-1619-3175-4050-4681.notes: You may instead execute this combo by venturing into Tomb of Annihilation instead of Lost Mine of Phandelver.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness without summoning sickness

225-880-7705.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You control an additional creature.
225-880-7705.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Mole Man and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2741-3490-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-3490-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3277-4872-5144.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and exiling Ephemerate.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

855-1806-2060-5686-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2440-3263-5685.description:
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {4}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Eldrazi and Spawn you control.
Repeat.
2440-3263-5685.notes: The initial mana cost can be reduced if you control additional Eldrazi and/or Spawns.

2281-5147-6132.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

876-1170-1329-4708.description:
If needed, activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Emry.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4681-5256-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

1305-6575-6968.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

3698-3734-4375.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 5.

2523-4050-5297.description:
Activate Sarkhan's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing it to become a legendary 4/4 Dragon creature with flying, indestructible and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sarkhan.
When Sarkhan dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Sarkhan that isn't legendary.
Repeat using the Sarkhan token.

2534-4183-4685.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Prosperous Pirates with haste.
When the Prosperous Pirates token enters the battlefield, it and Coercive Recruiter trigger.
Resolve the Prosperous Pirates trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

4871-5433-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.
4871-5433-5686.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Goblin token.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

372-1309-2072.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Scrollshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1309-2072.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

575-2829-4319-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-2829-4319-5441.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Granite Witness.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1495-3334-4120.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-3334-4120.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-3334-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

2292-2867-3433-4871.description:
Cast Hornet Queen by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer four times by sacrificing Hornet Queen and three Insect tokens.
When Hornet Queen and the Insect tokens die, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability and Pitiless Plunderer each trigger four times.
Resolve all Demon of Dark Schemes triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve all Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 four times.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Demon of Dark Schemes by paying {2}{B} and {E}{E}{E}{E}, putting Hornet Queen from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

215-2557-3003-4050-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eleven artifacts.
215-2557-3003-4050-5176.description:
Cast Mycosynth Golem by paying {0}.
Radagast triggers, creating two 3/3 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Beasts, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Mycosynth Golem from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

575-863-1794.notablePrerequisites:
Vampirism attached to any creature you control except Ruthless Ripper.
You have at least one additional black card in hand.
575-863-1794.description:
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face-up and triggering its ability.
Ruthless Ripper dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Ruthless Ripper trigger from step 1, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

49-914-1799-2034.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
49-914-1799-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then onto the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

190-1321-4127.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Immortal Coil and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Activate Sentinel Totem by tapping and exiling it, exiling all cards from all graveyards.
Each opponent's Immortal Coil triggers, causing them to lose the game.

366-1218-2567.notablePrerequisites: you control at least four lands.
366-1218-2567.description:
Cast Tainted Strike, giving Purphoros +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Avenger of Zendikar.
Avenger of Zendikar enters, triggering itself and Purphoros.
Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a Plant token for each land you control.
The tokens enter, triggering Purphoros four times.
Resolve All Purphoros triggers giving each opponent ten poison counters.

439-4215-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
Arashin Sovereign dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Arashin Sovereign, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Arashin Sovereign's power.
Repeat.
